doc.title: Peter Vacher interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 18, 2001

title: British writers' attention to detail: Chris Sheridan
summary: Rowe praises British writers; Vacher describes Chris Sheridan's books on Basie, Monk and Cannonball Adderley.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: I don’t know if this is a generalization but the British writers seem to take great pride in details and making things absolutely correct, and I think of Chris Sheridan and the book on Count Basie that is unbelievable.
Sure. Do you know about the one he’s doing on Monk?
It’s due out anytime now. It’s 545 pages. And he’s done one on Cannonball Adderley as well.
I think it’s coming out anytime if not already. It’s probably emerged by now. Yeah I know Chris, he’s assiduous.
